paite: TOUPA aw, ka thute ah na bil hon doh inla, ka ngaihtuahnate ngaihtuah in.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La: Tamngaite Toh Tum Ding / Humbitna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.

paite: Ka kumpipa leh ka Pathian, ka kikou aw ngaikhia in, na kiang a thum ka hi ngal a.
english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

paite: TOUPA aw, zingsang in ka aw na za zel ding a; zingsang in ka thumna na ma ah ka gel hoih dimdiam ding a, ka hon na hungaih zel ding hi.
english: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

paite: Gilou-salou kipahpih Pathian na hi ngal kei a; mikhialte na kiang atung kei ding hi.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

paite: Miki-uangsakte na mitmuh in adingh thei kei ding ua; gitlouhna nna semte tengteng na hua hi.
english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

paite: Zuaugen hatte na hihmang ding a; TOUPA'N sisan suah hat leh khemhatmi akih nilouh hi.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

paite: Himahleh kei bel, na hoihna niphatna in, na inn ah ka hong lut ding a; laudan siam kawm in na tempul siangthou lam nga in ka hon be zel ding hi.
english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka melmate ziak in na diktatna in hon pi inla; na lampi ka ma ah kichiansak in.
english: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

paite: Akam uah ginomna himhim a-om, keila; asunglam uh gitlouh satlouhna ngen ahi; agawl uh han kihong ahi a; alei un mi aphat khempeuh uhi.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

paite: Pathian aw, amaute siam louh tangsak in amau hoihsaknate ngei pukna in zang uhen; atatlekna tampi ziak un sawnkhia in; na tung ah ahel ngal ua.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

paite: Nangmah a ginna koihte nangmah ah kipak uhenla, na humbit zel ziak in nuam in kikou nilouh uhen; na min itte leng nangmah ah kipaktak in om uhen.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

paite: Midiktat na vualzawl ding a; TOUPA aw, amah phaw bang in, deihsakna in na umsuak ding hi.
english: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
